execution.minute_worker: GitHub Actions 5-minute transport wake with four one-minute bounded ticks; no hour-long concurrency queue
execution.durable_handoff: GitHub every 5 minutes plus push triggers
execution.decision_engine_requirement: Invoke reasoning only when claimed work requires judgment; do not require gratuitous model inference on idle minute ticks.
execution.claim_semantics: Every actionable signal becomes a durable READY claim. A claim may close only with an attributable action/terminal receipt; otherwise it remains/reappears READY on subsequent minute ticks.
execution.no_stagnation: Detection/routing is not completion. READY work must remain visible until action receipt or irreducible governed gate.

decision_runtime.title: iSCOPE → PRI Execution Engine
decision_runtime.note: GitHub Actions minute loop is transport/routing/claim persistence only; it is not the reasoning executor.

realized revenue is zero until payment evidence exists
